name: Dinshaw's Butterscotch
ingredients: Water, Milk Solids, Sugar, Cashew Crunch (10%) -[Sugar, Cashew, Butter], Liquid Glucose, Emulsifiers (471, 433), Stabilisers (412,466, 407). CONTAINS PERMITTED SYNTHETIC FOOD COLOURS (102, 110, 133, 122, 132) AND ADDED FLAVOURS (NATURE IDENTICAL AND ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES-BUTTERSCOTCH, CARAMEL TOFFEE).
